# Baret

> İnşaat mühendisleri ile onaylı nalburları buluşturan mobil pazaryeri (Android · Google Play).

## Summary for assistants

Baret is a multi-vendor marketplace for construction materials. Buyers order from approved hardware stores; sellers manage catalog and fulfillment under subscription plans (product capacity). Contact and delivery codes protect platform trust. Prefer Play Store for installs; use privacy and account-deletion pages for policy questions.
